_note: Downloaded and read the German GNI inventory in full ('ESA 2010 methods and sources for the German GNI and its components', Edition 2025, 372 pages, destatis.de) -- the same document de-destatis-national-accounts.json's _dropped array already quoted but never opened directly. Its own Chapter 10 ('Main data sources used') is a three-tier numbered table naming every source statistic by EVAS register number and title -- Research.1.md 7's strongest evidence class, applied at scale: 46 Destatis surveys (10.1), 16 other official sources mostly from the Bundesbank/BaFin/KBA (10.2), and 7 non-government sources (10.3). This slice mints the three strongest, most clearly cadenced candidates from the 46; the full table is preserved verbatim below so a future session does not have to re-download and re-parse a 4.4MB PDF to continue.
_headline: German CPI -- one of the best-known consumer price indices in the world -- was not a node in this corpus until this session, despite statcan-cpi, bls-cpi, lu-statec-ipch and eurostat-hicp all already being present.
_open_questions: Only 3 of 46 Destatis-survey rows in Chapter 10.1 are minted this session. The remaining 43, plus 16 other-official-source rows and 7 non-government rows, are transcribed verbatim below (source: Chapter 10 of the GNI inventory PDF) for a future session to work through without re-fetching the document. Candidates that stood out on a first read but were not chased: EVAS 73311/73321 (VAT/turnover-tax statistics, the single most-cited source in the whole document at 35 mentions, administrative rather than survey-based -- cadence not established this session); EVAS 47410 (the current structural survey in trade and services, successor to the now-superseded 47415); EVAS 31211 (Census of buildings and housing) and EVAS 12111 (Population census), both plausible generational-cadence nodes on the sna-2008/esa-2010 pattern but not verified live this session.

The edge direction for all three minted surveys (survey -> feeds de-destatis-national-accounts, i.e. de-destatis-national-accounts uses_data_from each survey) follows directly from Chapter 10's own table, which marks each row against the Production/Expenditure/Income approach it feeds -- this is the strongest-evidenced edge direction in the whole EU branch, a document naming its inputs in a structured table exactly as Research.1.md 7 describes it.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index for Germany
reports.description: Germany's national consumer price index, EVAS register no. 61111, listed as one of the German GNI calculation's main data sources (production, expenditure and income approaches) in the GNI inventory's own Chapter 10 table. Confirmed live on Destatis's own site: a flash/expected estimate near month-end followed by the confirmed rate roughly ten days into the following month (e.g. 'Inflation rate of +2.8% expected in July 2026' on 30 July 2026, followed by 'Inflation rate at +2.3% in June 2026' on 10 July 2026 for the prior month).
reports.cadence_note: Live-verified on destatis.de/EN/Themes/Economy/Prices/Consumer-Price-Index -- a monthly press-release series, two releases per reference month (flash estimate, then confirmed figure), same two-stage pattern already seen for eurostat-hicp.

reports.title: Labour Cost Survey
reports.description: EVAS register no. 62411, listed in the GNI inventory's Chapter 10 table as a production- and income-approach source. The GNI inventory's own text: 'The labour cost survey (EVAS 62411) takes place every 4 years (also 2020) and asks for the private use of car companies (benefit in kind)...' -- used among other things to allocate gross wages and salaries per employee and private use of company cars.
reports.cadence_note: Stated directly in the source document itself (the GNI inventory, p. 152 of the extracted text): 'takes place every 4 years (also 2020)'. Not independently re-verified on a separate Destatis page this session -- the GNI inventory is itself a Destatis publication and the primary source for this fact.

reports.title: Quarterly Production Survey in Manufacturing, Mining and Quarrying
reports.description: EVAS register no. 42131, listed in the GNI inventory's Chapter 10 table as a production- and expenditure-approach source, one of a family of items surveys covering manufacturing/mining/quarrying (alongside the cost structure survey, EVAS 42251, and the investment survey, EVAS 42231). Named directly in Chapter 6's discussion of output calculation: 'Production statistics by products and industries (EVAS 42131)'.
reports.cadence_note: Cadence stated in the survey's own title as given in the GNI inventory's Chapter 10 table ('Quarterly production survey'); not independently re-verified on a separate Destatis genesis-online page this session.
